verdict.claim: The model-side transform publication boundary is statically identified, but no safe combined player-and-nameplate correction seam is established. Runtime evidence must still prove local-player ownership, 30 Hz input cadence, per-render callback ordering, and the NamePlate cache producer. The player-specific vertex register also remains unresolved.

runtimeObservations.provenance: Maintainer-reported retail observations from 2026-09-14; the local video is not repository evidence.
facts: Player Y advances at approximately 30 Hz while Present runs near 60 FPS.
The retail 30 FPS limit removes the visible player, nameplate, slope, and camera stepping.
CameraActor update 0x006195D0 runs once per presented frame and CameraActor+0x250 already yields smooth camera world Y at 60 FPS.
The fixed-function D3DTS_VIEW transform remains identity.
runtimeObservations.consequence: CameraActor, D3DTS_VIEW, aspect ratio, navmesh, collision, server movement, packets, and authoritative actor coordinates are outside this correction investigation.

proven: Actor+0x0C owns the ModelObject used by both CharaActor slot 34 and UPDATE_MODEL_TRANSFORM.
CharaActor slot 34 returns ModelObject+0x30 to the controlled-actor tick.
On its attached-source path, UPDATE_MODEL_TRANSFORM builds a 0x40-byte record and writes it to ModelObject+0x50..+0x8C through slot 26; slot 7 is then invoked when Actor+0x0C is non-null.

When its drawable and dirty-bit guards pass, ModelObject slot 7 obtains the cached record, optionally transforms it under bit 0x10, and copies the resulting record to drawable+0x30..+0x6C through 0x00BB7550.
unresolved: Static evidence does not prove that the slot-34 sample and the 0x40-byte publication change on the same 30 Hz frames.
Static evidence does not join drawable+0x30..+0x6C to a player-specific vertex-shader constant task or register.
The callback dispatcher and phase ordering relative to player draw are not resolved.

namePlateFlow.proven: CharaElement per-actor tick 0x0058DF90 invokes slot 13 on the inline NamePlate subobject at CharaElement+0xBA0 and passes the CharaElement pointer as actor_context. Slot 13 reads NamePlate+0x78..+0x84, sends changed values through 0x00938020, and caches them at +0x98..+0xA4.
namePlateFlow.unresolved: No direct static writer other than constructor initialization was found for NamePlate+0x78..+0x84. Indirect production, its relation to ModelObject+0x30 or drawable state, and its runtime cadence remain unresolved.

runtimeProbe.successCriteria: A correction seam requires proof that the local player's 0x008DEC70 input is held for two Presents, that publication precedes that player's draw on the render thread, that editing only the published 0x40-byte record does not feed ModelObject+0x30 or authoritative actor state, and that the separately observed NamePlate record has an equally bounded render-only producer.
runtimeProbe.currentBestSeam: 0x008DEC70 is the smallest exact model-side probe because it receives the complete 0x40-byte record after Actor-side construction and before drawable publication. It is not yet a safe correction seam and does not cover NamePlate.

ownershipBoundary.authoritative: The controlled-actor tick and ModelObject+0x30 sample remain read-only probe inputs. This evidence does not authorize changing actor, collision, packet, server, or gameplay state.
ownershipBoundary.renderCandidate: ModelObject+0x50..+0x8C and drawable+0x30..+0x6C are downstream model/drawable caches, but render-only exclusivity is not proven until runtime caller and phase measurements close the listed gaps.
ownershipBoundary.launcherDisposition: Do not implement interpolation from static evidence alone. The launcher may implement only the exact ordered probe above.
